segments.text:
V. 33.
So—Like this Man, who being afraid to face his Enemy, ſends to make Peace with him, every one who forſaketh not all that he hath—I. By withdrawing his Affections from all the Creatures; 2. By enjoying them only in and for GOD, only in ſuch a Meaſure and Manner as leads to Him; 3. By hating them all, in the Senſe above-mentioned, cannot be my diſciple—But will furely deſiſt from building that Tower, neither can he perſevere in fighting the good Fight of Faith.
